changes.text: LingBot-Touch: five-finger tactile encoder for piezoresistive, magnetic and visuotactile hands, pretrained on 4,983 h from gloves and robot hands; Tiny and Small encoder weights released under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face, pretraining data not released.

Ego2Real: 1,123-taxel tactile gloves refine egocentric hand-object references and RL contact rewards for two OmniHand 3 hands; 12 of 15 real bottle handovers against 2 of 15 for REGRIND; no release stated.
BAT-WAM: world-action model that completes and predicts full-hand touch on a Linker Hand L6 with a Juqiao glove; 79.3% mean success on seven real tasks, evaluated on HT-Bench; no release stated.

Touch2Robot: retargeter from 256-taxel Juqiao glove touch and hand motion to LEAP Hand joints and predicted robot contact; demonstrations replay at 72.1% average completion against 37.9% for visual feedback; no release stated.

TouchWGNN: graph network on 113 piezoresistive taxels across a Shadow Hand estimating object state for reorientation; 90.56% cube success in Isaac Gym, real deployment shown qualitatively; no code given.
Touch2Trace: cable-tracing policy on a Tesollo DG-5F using two 32x32 TacV5 fingertip pressure images; 93% SR@10 against 0% without touch, from 16 demonstrations; no release stated.
ViTacPhys: estimates object mass, friction and stiffness from human fingertip pressure arrays and wrist RGB over 60 objects (1,800 demonstrations); held-out mass accuracy 87.5%; no release stated.

GIFT: ACT policy trained on glove fingertip FSR forces in newtons, run on a TetherIA Aero hand with current-estimated force; median hold force 1.20 N against 2.55 N without force input; no release stated.
